general.title: General
general.subtitle: Identity and defaults for this workspace.

identity.title: Identity
identity.hint: How this workspace appears across the product.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.hint: Per-workspace fallbacks for new branches and PRs.

defaultBranch.label: Default branch
defaultBranch.sub: The branch new PRs target by default.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.hint: Hide this workspace without deleting any data.

archived.label: Archived
archived.sub: Archived workspaces are read-only and hidden from default views. You can restore at any time.

source.title: Source connection
source.subtitle: Where this workspace pulls code from and how protected branches behave.

gitHost.title: Git host
gitHost.hint: Pick where the repository lives. Switching providers requires re-auth.

connection.label: Connection
connection.sub: The user that authorized access to this repository.

repository.title: Repository
repository.hint: Read-only — change by reconnecting to a different repo.

defaultBranch.label: Default branch
defaultBranch.sub: Probed from the remote on every reconnect.

branchProtection.title: Branch protection
branchProtection.hint: Rules enforced on the default branch via the host.

prReview.label: Require pull-request review
prReview.sub: At least one approving review before merge.

statusChecks.label: Require status checks
statusChecks.sub: CI must pass on the merge commit.

forcePush.label: Restrict force push
forcePush.sub: Block force pushes to the default branch.

signingSecret.title: Webhook signing secret
signingSecret.hint: Used to verify webhook payloads from the host. Rotating invalidates the previous secret.

signingSecretRow.label: Signing secret
signingSecretRow.sub: Shown once at generation time. Store it in a secret manager.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect source?
disconnectDialog.description: Pipelines for this workspace will pause until a new source is connected. Existing history is preserved.

revealModal.title: Save your signing secret
revealModal.onlyTimeStrong: This is the only time we'll show it.
revealModal.body: After you close this dialog, the secret cannot be retrieved.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.subtitle: Map repo paths to owning teams. Rules generate the live CODEOWNERS file used by review automation.

codeowners.title: CODEOWNERS
codeowners.hint: Left: live preview generated from the rule editor. Right: structured edit surface.

generatedHeader.line2: # Last match wins. Add specific rules below the catch-all.

ownership.emptySub: Add a rule to start mapping paths to teams.
ownership.orderMatters: Order matters — last matching rule wins.
ownership.noOwners: no owners — files will be flagged
ownership.savingNote: Saving writes {{path}} on the default branch via the integration bot.

admission.title: Admission rules
admission.subtitle: Workspace-scoped admission gates. Inherits org defaults; per-rule overrides shown below.

rulesSection.title: Rules
rulesSection.hint: Override an org default by changing severity. Use Reset to fall back to inheritance.

admission.lockNote: Org owners can lock a rule, which removes the override option for this workspace.

review.title: Review policy
review.subtitle: Approval requirements, reviewer assignment, and merge gating for this workspace.

requiredApprovers.title: Required approvers
requiredApprovers.hint: Minimum sign-offs before a PR can merge.

minApprovers.label: Minimum approvers
minApprovers.sub: Counted as distinct human approvers. Owners count once.

excludeAuthor.label: Exclude author
excludeAuthor.sub: An author's own approval (e.g. on a co-authored PR) does not count toward the minimum.

dismissStale.label: Dismiss stale approvals on push
dismissStale.sub: Existing approvals are revoked when new commits land. Reviewers must re-approve.

autoAssignment.title: Auto-assignment
autoAssignment.hint: How reviewers get added when a PR opens.

strategy.label: Strategy
strategy.sub: Round robin rotates evenly. Load balanced picks whoever has the fewest open reviews. Codeowners-only assigns from CODEOWNERS matches alone.

maxReviewers.label: Max reviewers per PR
maxReviewers.sub: Cap auto-additions at {{count}}. Manual @mentions still work.

reviewerPool.title: Reviewer pool
reviewerPool.hint: Teams that auto-assignment can draw from. Toggling a team off removes them from the rotation.

frontend.name: Frontend
frontend.description: 12 members · UI, design system, web app

branchOverrides.title: Branch overrides
branchOverrides.hint: Per-branch approval minimums. More specific patterns win.

review.noOverrides: No overrides — every branch uses the default minimum.

blockConditions.title: Block conditions
blockConditions.hint: Hard merge blockers. Each is independent — any active block prevents merge.

blockSoleReviewer.label: Block if author is sole reviewer
blockSoleReviewer.sub: Prevents merging a PR where only the author has approved (e.g. via stale rotations).

blockUnresolved.label: Block on unresolved threads
blockUnresolved.sub: All review comment threads must be marked resolved before merge.

blockRedCI.label: Block if CI is red
blockRedCI.sub: Required check failures block merge regardless of approvals.

review.footerNote: Changes apply to PRs opened after save. Existing PRs keep the policy that was active when they opened.

fix.title: Fix pipeline
fix.subtitle: What the autonomous fix pipeline is allowed to do, how much it can spend, and where it pings humans.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.hint: Each switch widens fix-pipeline's blast radius. Off means a human still has to ratify the action.

allowAutoPr.label: Allow auto-PR creation
allowAutoPr.sub: Fix-pipeline can open a PR with the proposed patch. The PR still needs human merge.

allowAutoMerge.label: Allow auto-merge on green
allowAutoMerge.sub: If checks pass and obligations below are met, fix-pipeline merges without human approval. Highest blast radius.

allowRollback.label: Allow rollback
allowRollback.sub: Fix-pipeline can revert its own merged PRs if downstream signals (errors, latency) regress.

resourceCaps.title: Resource caps
resourceCaps.hint: Hard ceilings so a runaway loop can't drain the budget.

fix.spendPauseNote: Fix-pipeline will pause itself when month-to-date spend hits the cap.

perRunTokenCap.label: Per-run token cap
perRunTokenCap.sub: Caps a single fix attempt. The pipeline will short-circuit and report partial findings.

perRunWallTime.label: Per-run wall-time cap
perRunWallTime.sub: Real time, not CPU time. A run exceeding this is killed and marked timed-out.

allowedBranches.title: Allowed branches
allowedBranches.hint: Glob patterns. Fix-pipeline will only open PRs against branches matching one of these.

fix.noPatterns: No patterns. Fix-pipeline is effectively disabled.

requiredObligations.title: Required obligations
requiredObligations.hint: Gates that must pass before fix-pipeline is allowed to act. If any fail, the run is held for human review.

noSecrets.label: no-secrets
noSecrets.sub: No diff lines match the secret scanner before fix-pipeline acts.

testsPass.label: tests-pass
testsPass.sub: All required test suites must be green on the source SHA.

lintClean.label: lint-clean
lintClean.sub: Lint passes with no errors (warnings allowed).

notificationRouting.title: Notification routing
notificationRouting.hint: Where fix-pipeline pings humans for each outcome. Channel input accepts Slack channels or emails.

onSuccess.label: On success
onSuccess.sub: A short note on the merged PR and target channel.

onFailure.label: On failure
onFailure.sub: Posted with the failing obligation, last error, and a link to the run.

onRollback.label: On rollback
onRollback.sub: Distinct channel so reverts don't get lost in the failure stream.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Per-workspace agent activation. Disabled agents won't be triggered by any event in this workspace.
agents.footerNote: Agents share the workspace token cap and inherit org-level AI policies. Concurrency is per agent, not per repo.

reviewBot.name: Review bot
reviewBot.description: Drafts PR review comments and suggestions on opened PRs.

fixPipeline.name: Fix pipeline
fixPipeline.description: Autonomously patches failing checks and opens PRs.

admissionBot.name: Admission bot
admissionBot.description: Evaluates admission rules on each PR; posts the verdict.

docWriter.name: Doc writer
docWriter.description: Updates README and inline docs when public APIs change.

depBumper.name: Dep bumper
depBumper.description: Opens PRs to bump dependencies, with changelog summaries.

flakeFixer.name: Flake fixer
flakeFixer.description: Detects flaky tests and proposes deflaking patches.

securityScanner.name: Security scanner
securityScanner.description: Scans diffs for vulnerable patterns and CVE-affected deps.

refactorSuggester.name: Refactor suggester
refactorSuggester.description: Spots high-churn modules and proposes structural cleanups.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.subtitle: Encrypted values used by CI runs, agents, and webhooks. Values are write-once: once stored, they can be rotated but not re-displayed.

rotateAll.title: Rotate all secrets
rotateAll.body: Generates new values for every secret in this workspace. Any CI run / agent run still using the old value will fail until it picks up the new one.

secrets.storedDescription: Copy this value now — for security, it can't be shown again. You can rotate to generate a new one later.
secrets.deleteDescription: Any CI run, agent, or webhook resolving this secret will start failing immediately. This cannot be undone.
secrets.rotateAllDescription: New values will be generated for every secret in this workspace. In-flight runs holding the old values will fail until they pick up the new ones. New values will be shown once, then never again.

environments.title: Environments
environments.subtitle: Targets this workspace deploys to. Each environment owns its own URL, region, and promotion gate.
environments.heading: Environments · {{count}}

drawer.blockDirectPushSub: Only the promotion gate can deploy here. Direct pushes are rejected.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: HTTP callbacks fired from workspace-level events: pull requests, branch policy, deploys, and code-quality signals.
webhooks.descPlaceholder: e.g. CI mirror for PR + deploy events

endpoints.ci: CI mirror for PR + deploy events

labels.title: Labels
labels.subtitle: Tag taxonomy for issues and pull requests in this workspace.
labels.emptySub: Create your first label to get started.
labels.deleteDescription_one: will be removed from {{count}} item. This can't be undone.
labels.deleteDescription_other: will be removed from {{count}} items. This can't be undone.
labels.descPlaceholder: Short description shown in pickers and lists

seed.bug: Something is not working as expected.
seed.refactor: Internal restructuring with no behavior change.
seed.design: UI, UX, or visual system change.
seed.discussion: Open question, RFC, or design debate.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.subtitle: Irreversible actions that affect this entire workspace.

archive.title: Archive workspace
archive.hint: Hide this workspace from default views without losing any data.

archivedRow.label: Archived
archivedRow.sub: Archived workspaces are read-only. Pipelines pause and the workspace is hidden from the launcher. You can restore at any time.

transfer.title: Transfer workspace
transfer.hint: Move this workspace to a different organization you own.

transferRow.label: Transfer to another org
transferRow.sub: The new org becomes the billing owner. Members keep access if they belong to the destination org.

delete.title: Delete workspace
delete.hint: Permanently remove this workspace and all attached data.

deleteRow.label: Permanently delete workspace
deleteRow.sub: Deletes pipelines, agent history, secrets, labels, and webhooks. Source repository is untouched.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.descriptionPrefix: This permanently deletes the workspace, every pipeline run, agent thread, secret, label, and webhook attached to it. The source repository is not touched. Type

transferDialog.title: Transfer {{name}}?
transferDialog.descriptionPrefix: This moves the workspace to the destination org and re-attaches billing. Type
